summary: Frontend retest of the 1-line i18n listener fix in /app/frontend/lib/i18n.ts (initI18n now calls `listeners.forEach((cb) => { try { cb(chosen); } catch {} });` after `i18n.locale = chosen;`). VERDICT: FIX CONFIRMED WORKING — the iteration-13 regression is resolved. All 4 requested scenarios pass on web: (1) Pre-set lang to 'en', force-reload → Settings header renders 'Settings and activity' AND Language picker shows the red checkmark-circle on lang-en (NOT on Français), confirmed by reading the icon color rgb(224, 26, 79) on the English row only; (2) Picking Français from the picker correctly routes back to /settings, header switches to 'Paramètres et activité', and row-language subtext reads 'Français'; (3) Picking Arabic → storage='ar', after force-reload Settings header shows 'الإعدادات والنشاط' and re-opening the picker shows the red checkmark on lang-ar; reverting to FR works and persists storage='fr'; (4) All three legal docs (cgu / privacy / legal) open with their localized titles ('Conditions Générales d'Utilisation', 'Politique de Confidentialité', 'Mentions Légales') and NO red screen — RootErrorBoundary not triggered. Listener notification pump is back in initI18n and useTranslation hooks now sync their `lang` state on first launch regardless of mount order. Native TestFlight crash remains out of scope as previously documented.

action_items: No retest needed for the listener fix — verified working end-to-end. Safe to hand off to user.

Optional follow-up (low priority, NOT a regression): localize the remaining hardcoded-FR strings in settings.tsx flagged above using existing t() keys (or add new dictionary keys for the modal titles).

Optional hardening on /language onPick: replace the `if (code === lang) router.back();` early-return with a comparison against `i18n.locale` (source of truth) instead of the React state, to protect against any future stale-state regression. Currently not blocking since the listener fix keeps `lang` in sync, but defense-in-depth would help.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.ts fix is correctly placed BEFORE `return chosen;` (lines 86-88) and wrapped in try/catch per callback — clean implementation matching iteration 13's recommendation verbatim.

The fix preserves the defensive refactor's original intent: still does NOT call I18nManager.forceRTL on first init (which was the root cause of the iOS first-mount crash). Only the listener pump was restored.

language.tsx still uses React-state `lang` for the active-row comparison and the onPick early-return. Now safe because the listener fix syncs state, but consider using i18n.locale as belt-and-suspenders.
